main:1.text: A Gift from the Past is the first main quest of Horizon Zero Dawn. Six years after her naming ceremony, while venturing across the Embrace, Aloy finds herself trapped in a ruin and must find a way to escape. Aloy was rescued by Rost from the ruins, with him deciding to teach her to hunt machines the following day.

main:2.text: Lessons of the Wild is the second main quest of Horizon Zero Dawn. Following the tumultuous cave escape, Rost decides that Aloy is ready to learn the ways of hunting, gathering, and crafting taught in the Nora tribe. She is sent on her first task to hunt machines, including the Watcher and the Strider.

main:3.text: The Point of the Spear is the third main quest of Horizon Zero Dawn. After years of intense training, Aloy has grown from a child to an adult. Rost wishes to impart her with a last bit of hunting knowledge before she attends the Proving. Aloy is now old enough to enter the Proving, which takes place in two days. In the morning, Aloy finds Rost overlooking the Embrace, clearly troubled by something.

main:4.text: Mother's Heart is the fourth main quest in Horizon Zero Dawn. Aloy gains access to the Nora capital of Mother's Heart for the first time. Inside, she will take part in an annual festival before the start of the Proving. Aloy meets Rost outside the gates of Mother's Heart. He tells her to meet High Matriarch Teersa who will lead her through an annual festival before the start of the Proving.

main:5.text: The Proving is the fifth main quest in Horizon Zero Dawn. Aloy will finally undergo the Proving to become a full member of the Nora tribe. However, the event does not go as planned. Aloy, Bast, Vala, and other Nora follow a proctor to the Proving grounds. The ceremony begins with the initiates rock climbing to the starting area. Then there is a hunting test.

main:6.text: The Womb of the Mountain is the sixth main quest in Horizon Zero Dawn. After surviving the massacre at the Proving, Aloy rests and heals inside the mountain at Mother's Watch. The High Matriarchs reveal important new information to Aloy and send her off on an important quest for the Nora tribe. Aloy wakes inside the sacred mountain, a place where only the Matriarchs are allowed inside.

main:7.text: A Seeker at the Gates is the seventh main quest in Horizon Zero Dawn. Aloy sets off outside the Embrace. The route to Meridian requires her to pass through the Carja border checkpoint at Daytower. En route, she sees the destruction wrought by the Corruptors. With the new device that allowed her to override machines, Aloy successfully uses it to override a Strider, which she uses as a mount to travel faster.

main:8.text: The City of the Sun is the tenth main quest in Horizon Zero Dawn. Aloy begins her journey to Meridian, the Carja capital to find Olin, the Oseram whom she met before the day of the Proving Massacre. As Aloy reaches the city, she finds that an angry crowd of Carja artisans have gathered outside the main bridge, halted by the Carja guards.

main:9.text: Maker's End is the fourteenth main quest in Horizon Zero Dawn. Intent on learning more about the mysterious woman that she so closely resembles, Aloy journeys to Maker's End, the Old Ones ruin in northeast of Sunfall. After stocking up on a cache of supplies left by the unknown caller outside the ruins, she discovers a number of Corrupted machines guarding the site where the Eclipse have begun excavations.

main:10.text: The Grave-Hoard is the fifteenth main quest in Horizon Zero Dawn. Still no closer to understanding her connection to Elisabet Sobeck nor why the Eclipse specifically targeted her at the Proving, Aloy travels to the Grave-Hoard, the ruins of U.S. Robot Command in the eastern mountains to find more answers. As Aloy nears the ruins, she sees a number of Eclipse agents and corrupted machines.

main:11.text: To Curse the Darkness is the sixteenth main quest in Horizon Zero Dawn. Still no closer to understanding what Project Zero Dawn is after exploring the ruins of the U.S.R.C., Sylens informs Aloy that their next stop lies buried beneath Sunfall, the Shadow Carja capital.

main:12.text: Deep Secrets of the Earth is the seventeenth main quest in Horizon Zero Dawn. After successfully infiltrating the Eclipse base and taking down their Focus network, Aloy makes her way to Sunfall, the Shadow Carja capital. There she hopes to find more answers about Elisabet Sobeck and Project Zero Dawn.

main:13.text: The Terror of the Sun is the eighteenth main quest in Horizon Zero Dawn. It begins immediately after Deep Secrets of the Earth. Aloy awakens to find herself unarmed and unarmored, suspended in a cage above the Sun-Ring. Helis approaches, telling her that before she crashed the Eclipse network, he sent an order out to rally the Eclipse to invade the Sacred Lands. He then destroys her Focus and leaves her.

main:14.text: The Heart of the Nora is the nineteenth main quest in Horizon Zero Dawn. Parting ways with Sylens after escaping the Sun-Ring, Aloy makes her way back to the Embrace to defend her home from the Eclipse. Fast travel into the Embrace is not possible, with the campfire outside of the Main Embrace Gate being the closest campfire that can be fast travelled to.

main:15.text: The Mountain that Fell is the twentieth main quest in Horizon Zero Dawn. After hearing GAIA's Dying Plea and learning the location of the weapon that will allow her to defeat HADES, Aloy makes her way to the GAIA Prime facility.

main:16.text: The Looming Shadow is the twenty-first main quest in Horizon Zero Dawn. After realizing HADES's intention to capture the Spire to reawaken the Faro robots and obtaining the Master Override that will allow her to defeat it, Aloy journeys back to the Palace of the Sun to warn Sun-King Avad of the coming threat.

main:17.text: The Face of Extinction is the twenty-second and final main quest in Horizon Zero Dawn. In the early hours of the next day, Aloy is awoken by a Carja guard to inform her that there have been signs from the west of the Eclipse's advance.

main:18.text: The War-Chief's Trail is the eighth main quest in Horizon Zero Dawn. After talking with Varl at the gates of Mother's Watch, Aloy learns of the failed war party led by War-Chief Sona that has gone missing. As the son of Sona, Varl pleads with Aloy to find her. Aloy makes her way to the battlefield where the Nora war party was last spotted. The field is littered with the corpses of machines and Nora Braves.

main:19.text: Revenge of the Nora is the ninth main quest in Horizon Zero Dawn. After finding War-Chief Sona and her Nora Braves, Aloy helps the group counterattack a group of killers within Devil's Thirst. Sona then tells Aloy that their work is not done. After tracking the remains of the Cultist group near some ruins at Devil's Grief, the Nora look to exact revenge for the Proving Massacre.

main:20.text: The Field of the Fallen is the eleventh main quest in Horizon Zero Dawn. After witnessing the power of Aloy's Focus while exploring Olin's Apartment during The City of the Sun, Erend asks her to help him uncover the identity of the Shadow Carja soldier responsible for killing his sister Ersa. Aloy agrees to meet Erend in Red Ridge Pass.

main:21.text: Into the Borderlands is the twelfth main quest in Horizon Zero Dawn. Met with the realization that Erend's sister Ersa may still be alive after discovering the ambush was staged, Erend heads back to Meridian to re-examine the body. Upon arriving at the Sun-King's palace, Aloy is escorted by Blameless Marad to meet with Sun-King Avad and Erend.

main:22.text: The Sun Shall Fall is the thirteenth main quest in Horizon Zero Dawn. When Aloy and Erend finally track down Erend's sister Ersa during the main quest Into the Borderlands, before dying she warns them of a destructive plan hatched by her kidnapper, the Oseram warlord Dervahl, to cause an explosion in Meridian.

side:1.text: In Her Mother's Footsteps is a side quest in Horizon Zero Dawn. An injured Nora father, Thok, asks for Aloy's assistance in finding his daughter, Arana, who has gone in solitary pursuit of her mother's spear embedded in a Scrapper. The spear, made by Thok's deceased wife and Arana's mother, Edena, became lodged in a Scrapper after Thok failed to defeat it.

side:2.text: The Forgotten is a side quest in Horizon Zero Dawn. Olara's troubled brother, Brom, has gone missing. Brom was exiled from the Nora tribe for ten years and lived in a camp outside of the major settlements. When his sentence was over, he did not return. Olara petitioned the Matriarchs to send Braves looking for him, but they found only his abandoned, blood-soaked camp.

side:3.text: Ancient Armory is a side quest in Horizon Zero Dawn. Tucked into the Sacred Lands of the Nora is a long-forgotten bunker of the Old Ones that contains a curious set of armor sealed away behind locked Ancient Doors. To gain access, Aloy must collect five Power Cells located throughout the world.

side:4.text: Insult to Injury is a side quest in Horizon Zero Dawn. Aloy can receive this quest from one of two Nora healers: Enara in Mother's Heart and Fia in Mother's Rise. In Mother's Rise, Aloy can speak to Fia who is tending to a Brave that was fatally wounded in the nearby ambush following the Proving Massacre.

side:5.text: Underequipped is a side quest in Horizon Zero Dawn. This quest is given by Lubavad, the operator of a trading caravan company. He is encountered during Aloy's first trip to Hunter's Gathering. After failing to recruit the Banuk hunter Opitak to deliver ammunition to one of his caravans that was accidentally left behind before they left on an expedition to trade with the Banuk, he accepts Aloy's offer to help.

side:6.text: A Moment's Peace is a side quest in Horizon Zero Dawn. While in Meridian, Aloy meets Vilgund, who tells her of a remote Banuk camp in the northern region, near the Anvil of the Moon, where machines are entirely docile. Vilgund sent two of his men to the camp to find out exactly what might be happening but has not heard back from them.

side:7.text: A Daughter's Vengeance is a side quest in Horizon Zero Dawn. While at Mother's Rise, Aloy encounters a young Nora man named Yan making supplication to All-Mother. Yan tells Aloy that his prayers are for All-Mother to watch over his sister Nakoa, who had left to find and exact vengeance upon Zaid, a brutal Carja captain who had murdered and mutilated their father before her eyes during the Red Raids.

side:8.text: Fatal Inheritance is a side quest in Horizon Zero Dawn. While in Meridian Village, Aloy overhears a young Carja man named Ranaman berating a member of the Vanguard for his refusal to help deal with machines that have been incessantly attacking his father's estate. After the Guardsman leaves, Aloy approaches Ranaman.

side:9.text: Heap of Trouble is a side quest in Horizon Zero Dawn. This quest can be started by ascending the tallest tower in Free Heap and talking to Petra. Upon arriving, Aloy meets the amicable Oseram inventor Petra Forgewoman, the leader of the settlement. A group of bandits has come between the Oseram and some valuable power cells in their foundry, and are trying to drive the Oseram off the claim.

side:10.text: Acquired Taste is a side quest in Horizon Zero Dawn. Aloy stumbles upon a small wooden shack in the western region of the Sundom. Inside she finds an exiled Banuk shaman named Brin. Aloy notices that the shaman has been wounded, apparently by a Sawtooth. He explains that he was attempting to drink the machine’s blood when he was attacked.

side:11.text: Cause for Concern - Farewell is a side quest in Horizon Zero Dawn. After clearing out all six Bandit Camps, Nil invites Aloy to join him on a mesa south of Meridian, overlooking the Spearshafts. Upon climbing up to the mesa, with a number of bandit corpses can be seen lying around the camp, Nil challenges Aloy to a duel to the death. Aloy reluctantly agrees to the fight, much to Nil's delight.

side:12.text: Sun and Shadow is a side quest in Horizon Zero Dawn. In Brightmarket, Aloy encounters a nobleman leaning over a bridge and searching the river. The man, Lahavis, explains that his young daughter, Elida, has gone missing after last being seen in the family's garden. He fears Elida, depressed over the ongoing Carja civil war, may have committed suicide.

side:13.text: Sunstone Rock is a side quest in Horizon Zero Dawn. While traveling through the Jewel, Aloy hears a commotion at Sunstone Rock, a small settlement far in the south of the Sundom. Upon approach, Aloy sees that Carja guards are attempting to take down two Behemoths who have descended on the settlement. After helping dispatch the Behemoths, Aloy is greeted by the guards and told to visit Janeva inside.

side:14.text: Blood on Stone is a side quest in Horizon Zero Dawn. When five night guards are mysteriously killed in the quarry at Cut-Cliffs, Aloy agrees to investigate the cause of the murders. Talking to the Quarry Foreman, Aloy learns that one of the guards, Saravad, was a friend of his from their days as slave miners during the reign of Sun-King Jiran.

side:15.text: Death from the Skies is a side quest in Horizon Zero Dawn. Southeast of Pitchcliff in Dryrun Canyon, Aloy encounters an injured Oseram, Hakurt, who uses his dying breaths to beg the huntress to help the nearby settlement which has come under attack from Glinthawks.

side:16.text: Hunters' Blind is a side quest in Horizon Zero Dawn. After delivering her first set of trophies to Ahsis, Aloy speaks to Talanah, who tells her that instead of going after Redmaw, there is something else that needs attending to.

side:17.text: Robbing the Rich is a side quest in Horizon Zero Dawn. While walking through Meridian, Aloy is called over by a Carja noble named Ravan who has heard about her ability to use the "second sight" of her Focus to solve crimes. He asks her to investigate a theft that has occurred in his lavish downtown villa. A precious family heirloom has been stolen from his home.

side:18.text: Weapons of the Lodge is a side quest in Horizon Zero Dawn. After Aloy earns enough marks to enter the Hunters Lodge in Meridian, she is able to speak with the Lodge's special merchant, Aidaba, who explains that the Lodge rewards its members with powerful weapons for completing trials at Hunting Grounds. As a Fledgling, Aloy is eligible to participate.

side:19.text: Honor The Fallen is a side quest in Horizon Zero Dawn. Mournful Namman wishes to support Sun-King Avad's push for peace by helping three pilgrims from different tribes in the region mourn loved ones lost during the Red Raids. The first is an Oseram pilgrim, Brageld, who along with a number of other Oseram wishes to visit the Shrine of Kings to remember those who were held as slave builders.

side:20.text: Redmaw was a legendarily infamous and immensely powerful Thunderjaw among the Carja and a highly sought after kill by members of the Hunters Lodge. Many hunters met their end trying to take it down, including Talanah's sponsor, Tarkas, and Ahsis. Redmaw's history was chronicled by Inquiring Jandiniman, Historian-In-Residence at the Hunters Lodge.

side:21.text: Traitor's Bounty is a side quest in Horizon Zero Dawn. When Aloy arrives in Sunfall during Deep Secrets of the Earth, she gains access to the Citadel's throne room by blending in with a group of outlanders who are gathering to listen to High Priest Bahavas list the day’s bounties.

side:22.text: Queen's Gambit is a side quest in Horizon Zero Dawn. At the end of Traitor's Bounty, Vanasha reveals that the death of High Priest Bahavas has created a window of opportunity for the captive Dowager Queen Nasadi and her son, Prince Itamen, to defect from Sunfall and escape the Shadow Carja. Vanasha has quickly put a plan in place to get them across the Daybrink to Meridian under cloak of night.
